text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: New incident declared by @Rafael Mendes
Severity: SEV2
Summary: Elevated streaming disconnects + intermittent 5xx on Hosted Chat Completions (us-east-1)
Bridge: https://meet.google.com/redwood-incident-bridge
Zoom: n/a
Slack war room: #inc-2025-05-13-streaming

Required fields (taxonomy v1 trial):
• Category: Runtime / Streaming
• Impacted surface: Hosted API
• Region: us-east-1
• Customer tier: Hosted (self-serve + Enterprise)
• Primary owner (auto-suggested): Runtime Oncall

Rafael Mendes: Heads up, using the new category dropdown. I picked `Runtime / Streaming` bc symptom is stream drops. If that’s wrong please yell and we’ll correct.

Sean Gallagher: Ack. Let’s keep the category set but call out “suspected” in thread. Also pls note TTM clock is running; comms in 10.

Dev Patel: Support seeing 12+ tickets in last 5 mins, all mention “stream ended unexpectedly” + some 524-ish timeouts. Mostly us-east.

Mina Haddad: Looking at edge metrics now. Seeing spikes in `gateway_stream_reset_total` and `client_disconnect_rate` at the gateway layer, not (yet) in runtime pods. Can someone confirm runtime error rate?

Mateo Alvarez: Runtime dashboard: token gen stable, no pod restarts, GPU utilization normal. I’m not seeing runtime-level stream exceptions.

Sofia Ivanova: +1. Scheduler QPS normal, no queue buildup. If this were runtime streaming, we’d see `stream_write_err` in runtime logs. It’s flat.

Rafael Mendes: Ok so likely *not* runtime. The taxonomy category might be misleading here.

Victor Alvarez: Networking: us-east-1 ALB metrics show elevated 5xx from target resets + increase in `ELBConnectionErrorCount`. Also a bump in `envoy_downstream_cx_destroy_remote` on the gateway.

Ethan Park: Control plane is fine. No deploys in last 2h. Config diff? we did roll out gateway config in canary earlier.

Devon Price: For taxonomy trial: reminder we can edit category via `/incident update` if we learn more. It’s ok to reclass.

Sean Gallagher: Do it now. The owner auto-suggest is paging Runtime based on category. We need the correct oncall looped.

Rafael Mendes: Copy. Updating category + owner.

incident-bot: Incident updated by @Rafael Mendes
• Category: Runtime / Streaming  ->  Edge/Gateway / Streaming
• Primary owner: Runtime Oncall  ->  Infra/Networking Oncall

Mina Haddad: :thumbsup: thanks. For clarity: we don’t have a final “Edge/Gateway / Streaming” category in the v1 list, right? I don’t see it in the dropdown on my side.

Rafael Mendes: I picked closest thing: `Edge/Gateway / Connection handling` (the label is a bit weird). It’s basically “gateway streaming resets”.

Devon Price: Yeah the labels are rough. Current allowed values are:
- Edge/Gateway / Connection handling
- Edge/Gateway / TLS/DNS
- Network / Cloud provider
No explicit “streaming disconnect” callout.

Miles Thornton: Jumping in bc this is *exactly* what we worried about. We should capture: symptom is streaming-related, but likely gateway/edge not runtime.
Question for IC: would you have picked “Edge/Gateway / Connection handling” at declare time if the label had examples like “stream resets / chunked responses”?

Rafael Mendes: Probably yes, if it had examples. I picked runtime bc that’s where “streaming” lives in my head. The dropdown didn’t help.

Jasmine Liu: Comms draft for status page: “Some customers may see response streams disconnect in us-east-1; retries may succeed.” ETA for next update 15 min. Does that match?

Sean Gallagher: Yes. Also add workaround: disable streaming / set `stream=false` if possible.

Dev Patel: Sharing exact customer wording: “stream aborts after ~20-40s” and “it works if not streaming.” So workaround is real.

Victor Alvarez: Found correlate: gateway envoy in us-east hit connection buffer limit. Seeing log spam:
```
upstream reset: reset reason connection_termination
stream error: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers
```
Looks like a regression in the gateway config that changed buffer / flow control.

Ethan Park: That matches the canary config earlier. Which change set? I’m pulling the diff now.

Mina Haddad: I can roll back gateway config for us-east. ETA 5-7 min.

Sean Gallagher: Approve rollback. Prioritize mitigation over perfect root cause.

Mina Haddad: Executing rollback now.

incident-bot: Deploy-bot
Gateway config rollback started
Cluster: us-east-1
Rollout: 0% -> 100%
Tracking: https://grafana.redwood/rollouts/gw-rollback-0513

Mateo Alvarez: For the record: runtime was paged first due to category. We lost ~10-12 mins before we had infra/net + gateway engaged. This is going in the notes.

Miles Thornton: Please do. This is a taxonomy/ownership mapping failure mode, not just a human error.

Rafael Mendes: Metrics update: 5xx dropping. Streaming resets still elevated but trending down.

Victor Alvarez: Confirming: ALB 5xx returning to baseline. Envoy resets down ~60%.

Mina Haddad: Rollback complete. Seeing normal stream duration distributions again.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed by @Rafael Mendes
Status: Monitoring

Jasmine Liu: Posting status update now + noting workaround is no longer necessary but still ok if customers are nervous.

Dev Patel: Support confirming: new tickets stopped. Existing customers recovering.

Sean Gallagher: Keep monitoring 20 mins. Then resolve. Also: capture taxonomy notes while it’s fresh.

Rafael Mendes: 20 mins stable. Resolving.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed by @Rafael Mendes
Status: Resolved

Miles Thornton: Follow-up on taxonomy trial:
1) At declare time, “Runtime / Streaming” felt like the only obvious choice, but it mapped to wrong owning team.
2) We need either:
   - a clearer category name like `Edge/Gateway / Streaming & connection resets` (with examples), OR
   - a separate “Symptom” field (Streaming disconnects) vs “Cause category” (Edge vs Runtime) that can be `Unknown` initially.
3) Also suggest: allow `Triage / Unknown (choose within 15m)` for live incidents to avoid false ownership.

Devon Price: +1. From tooling side, we can:
- add helper text to category options in the modal
- add a “suspected vs confirmed” toggle
- make category required but allow `Triage / Unknown` with a reminder ping at +15m

Sean Gallagher: Please log this as v1 fix request. The whole point is reducing paging ambiguity; today we did the opposite.

Miles Thornton: Will do. I’ll add to working notes + propose category rename + examples:
- “Edge/Gateway / Streaming resets (Envoy/ALB)”
- “Runtime / Streaming write errors (engine)”

Mina Haddad: Can also add a decision rule to the policy doc:
- If runtime error rate flat but gateway `stream_reset` high -> pick Edge/Gateway
- If runtime `stream_write_err` or pod restarts -> pick Runtime

Rafael Mendes: +1. Also making category mandatory *at declare* is fine, but we should have the `Triage` escape hatch.

Victor Alvarez: Agree. In the moment, people pick what sounds right. Better to bias to correct ownership routing.

Miles Thornton: Captured. I’ll bring to taxonomy review. Thanks all.
